```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)
library(gplots)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)
```

# Count importing
```{r}
setwd("~/bystander_collaboration/bulk_data/count")

samples <- c(
"sample1_count",
"sample2_count",
"sample3_count",
"sample4_count",
"sample5_count",
"sample6_count",
"sample7_count",
"sample8_count",
"sample9_count",
"sample10_count",
"sample11_count",
"sample12_count"
);
infiles <- paste(samples, ".out", sep="");
inlist <- lapply(infiles, read.table);
alltrans <- unique(unlist(lapply(inlist, "[[", 1), use.names=FALSE));

## construct empty count matrix
CM <- structure(matrix(as.integer(NA),
                       nrow=length(alltrans),
                       ncol=length(samples)),
                dimnames=list(alltrans, samples))

## fill count matrix
for (i in 1:length(samples)) {
  CM[match(inlist[[i]]$V1, rownames(CM)), i] <- inlist[[i]]$V2;
}

## drop non-unique alignments and other non-gene entries
dropClasses <- c("__alignment_not_unique", "__no_feature", "__ambiguous",
                 "__too_low_aQual", "__not_aligned")

if (any(dropClasses %in% rownames(CM)))
  CM <- CM[-match(dropClasses, rownames(CM)),]

colnames(CM) <- c(
"mmLung_highPD1_MPCD4T_Rep1",
"mmLung_lowPD1_MPCD4T_Rep1",
"mmLung_highPD1_MPCD4T_Rep2",
"mmLung_lowPD1_MPCD4T_Rep2",
"mmLung_highPD1_MPCD4T_Rep3",
"mmLung_lowPD1_MPCD4T_Rep3",
"mmSpleen_highPD1_MPCD4T_Rep1",
"mmSpleen_lowPD1_MPCD4T_Rep1",
"mmSpleen_highPD1_MPCD4T_Rep2",
"mmSpleen_lowPD1_MPCD4T_Rep2",
"mmSpleen_highPD1_MPCD4T_Rep3",
"mmSpleen_lowPD1_MPCD4T_Rep3"
)
#write.csv(as.data.frame(CM), file="CM.csv")
```

## bulk data QC

```{r}
setwd("~/bystander_collaboration/bulk_data/analysis")

barplot(colSums(CM), col="sienna", las=2, cex.names=0.6, cex.axis=0.6, ylab="library size")
mtext(side=2, line=4.5, text="Number of transcript-counted reads", font=2)

## Make condition column for the sample information
cts <- CM
coldata <- as.data.frame(c("Lung_PD1high","Lung_PD1low","Lung_PD1high","Lung_PD1low","Lung_PD1high","Lung_PD1low","Spleen_PD1high","Spleen_PD1low","Spleen_PD1high","Spleen_PD1low","Spleen_PD1high","Spleen_PD1low"))
rownames(coldata) <- colnames(cts)
colnames(coldata) <- "condition"

## To extract normalized read count
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = cts, colData = coldata, design = ~ condition)
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep,]
dds <- DESeq(dds)
normcount <- counts(dds, normalized=TRUE)
```

## PCA analysis

```{r}
## VST transformation (for PCA and clustering)
vst_all <- vst(dds, blind=TRUE)
vst_mat <- assay(vst_all)

lung_samples <- c(
  "mmLung_highPD1_MPCD4T_Rep1",
  "mmLung_lowPD1_MPCD4T_Rep1",
  "mmLung_highPD1_MPCD4T_Rep2",
  "mmLung_lowPD1_MPCD4T_Rep2",
  "mmLung_highPD1_MPCD4T_Rep3",
  "mmLung_lowPD1_MPCD4T_Rep3"
)

spleen_samples <- c(
  "mmSpleen_highPD1_MPCD4T_Rep1",
  "mmSpleen_lowPD1_MPCD4T_Rep1",
  "mmSpleen_highPD1_MPCD4T_Rep2",
  "mmSpleen_lowPD1_MPCD4T_Rep2",
  "mmSpleen_highPD1_MPCD4T_Rep3",
  "mmSpleen_lowPD1_MPCD4T_Rep3"
)

# 샘플 메타데이터
sample_meta <- data.frame(
  sample    = colnames(vst_mat),
  organ     = ifelse(grepl("^mmLung",   colnames(vst_mat)), "Lung",   "Spleen"),
  condition = ifelse(grepl("highPD1", colnames(vst_mat)), "PD1-high", "PD1-low"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
sample_meta$group <- paste(sample_meta$organ, sample_meta$condition, sep=" ")

# PCA용 helper 함수
run_pca <- function(mat) {
  mat_filtered <- mat[apply(mat, 1, sd) > 0, ]
  prcomp(t(mat_filtered), center=TRUE, scale.=TRUE)
}

pct_var <- function(pca_res) {
  eig <- pca_res$sdev^2
  round(eig / sum(eig) * 100, 1)
}

pca_all <- run_pca(vst_mat)
pct_all <- pct_var(pca_all)
coord_all <- as.data.frame(pca_all$x)
coord_all$sample    <- rownames(coord_all)
coord_all <- merge(coord_all, sample_meta, by="sample")

# 색상: organ, 모양: condition
organ_col <- c("Lung"="steelblue", "Spleen"="tomato")
cond_pch  <- c("PD1-high"=16, "PD1-low"=1)

p_all <- ggplot(coord_all, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=organ, shape=condition, label=sample)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  geom_text(vjust=-0.8, size=2.5, show.legend=FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values=organ_col) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=cond_pch) +
  labs(title="Combined PCA (VST, Lung + Spleen)",
       x=paste0("PC1 (", pct_all[1], "%)"),
       y=paste0("PC2 (", pct_all[2], "%)")) +
  theme_bw()
print(p_all)
```

# PDCD1 expression comparison
```{r}
# PDCD1 norm count 추출
normcount_clean <- normcount
rownames(normcount_clean) <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(normcount_clean))

geneX <- "ENSMUSG00000026285"
geneX_expr <- normcount_clean[geneX, ]
geneX_expr

plot_df <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(normcount_clean),
  expression = normcount_clean[geneX, ],
  condition = coldata$condition
)

plot_df$log2_expr <- log2(plot_df$expression + 1)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = condition, y = log2_expr, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2) +
  labs(title = paste(geneX, "expression across conditions"),
       y = "log2(normalized count + 1)",
       x = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 조건별 평균값 확인
tapply(plot_df$log2_expr, plot_df$condition, mean)
```

# DESeq2 adjpvalue
```{r}
res_lung <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "Lung_PD1high", "Lung_PD1low"))
idx <- grep("^ENSMUSG00000026285", rownames(res_lung))
res_lung[idx, ]

res_spleen <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "Spleen_PD1high", "Spleen_PD1low"))
idx <- grep("^ENSMUSG00000026285", rownames(res_spleen))
res_spleen[idx, ]

library(ggsignif)

# adj p-value 추출
padj_lung <- res_lung[idx, ]$padj      # Lung 비교
padj_spleen <- res_spleen[idx, ]$padj  # Spleen 비교

# 별표 변환 함수
get_stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("ns")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  if (p < 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p < 0.05)  return("*")
  return("ns")
}

star_lung   <- get_stars(padj_lung)
star_spleen <- get_stars(padj_spleen)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = condition, y = log2_expr, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2) +
  
  # Lung 비교 (PD1high vs PD1low)
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("Lung_PD1high", "Lung_PD1low")),
    annotations = star_lung,
    y_position = max(plot_df$log2_expr) * 1.05,
    tip_length = 0.01
  ) +
  
  # Spleen 비교
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("Spleen_PD1high", "Spleen_PD1low")),
    annotations = star_spleen,
    y_position = max(plot_df$log2_expr) * 1.12,
    tip_length = 0.01
  ) +
  
  labs(title = "PDCD1 expression across conditions",
       y = "log2(normalized count + 1)",
       x = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
# PDCD1 expression comparison (t test)
```{r}
# Lung: PD1high vs PD1low
lung_high   <- plot_df$log2_expr[plot_df$condition == "Lung_PD1high"]
lung_low    <- plot_df$log2_expr[plot_df$condition == "Lung_PD1low"]

# Spleen: PD1high vs PD1low
spleen_high <- plot_df$log2_expr[plot_df$condition == "Spleen_PD1high"]
spleen_low  <- plot_df$log2_expr[plot_df$condition == "Spleen_PD1low"]

# t-test 수행
ttest_lung   <- t.test(lung_high, lung_low)
ttest_spleen <- t.test(spleen_high, spleen_low)

# p-value 확인
ttest_lung$p.value
ttest_spleen$p.value

# adj p-value (두 비교를 동시에 보정)
p_adjusted <- p.adjust(
  c(ttest_lung$p.value, ttest_spleen$p.value), 
  method = "BH"  # Benjamini-Hochberg
)
padj_lung_t   <- p_adjusted[1]
padj_spleen_t <- p_adjusted[2]

# 별표 변환 (기존 함수 재사용)
star_lung_t   <- get_stars(padj_lung_t)
star_spleen_t <- get_stars(padj_spleen_t)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = condition, y = log2_expr, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2) +
  
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("Lung_PD1high", "Lung_PD1low")),
    annotations = star_lung_t,
    y_position = max(plot_df$log2_expr) * 1.05,
    tip_length = 0.01
  ) +
  
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("Spleen_PD1high", "Spleen_PD1low")),
    annotations = star_spleen_t,
    y_position = max(plot_df$log2_expr) * 1.12,
    tip_length = 0.01
  ) +
  
  labs(title = "PDCD1 expression (t-test)",
       y = "log2(normalized count + 1)",
       x = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

## 특정 gene set 확인 Z score heatmap
```{r}
# ── 사용자 정의 gene set ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gene_set <- c("Pdcd1", "Bcl6", "Tnfsf8", "Spp1","Batf","Il13","Lgals1","Mki67","Il21","Ebi3","Ifngr1","Il7r","Rorc","Il23r","Il22","S1pr1")  # ← 여기에 원하는 유전자 입력
# geneset 2
#gene_set <- c("Ccr1","Ccr2","Ccr3","Ccr5","Ccr6","Ccr7","Ccr8","Ccr9","Cxcr3","Cxcr4","Cxcr5","Cxcr6","Cx3cr1","Xcr1")
                                                                                                                                            
 # Gene Symbol → ENSEMBL 변환
  gs_map <- bitr(gene_set,                                                                                                                  
                 fromType = "SYMBOL",
                 toType   = "ENSEMBL",                                                                                                      
                 OrgDb    = org.Mm.eg.db)
                                                                                                                                            
  # normcount에서 추출 (버전 suffix 제거)
  normcount_gs <- normcount
  rownames(normcount_gs) <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(normcount_gs))                                                                        
   
  mat_gs <- log2(normcount_gs[rownames(normcount_gs) %in% gs_map$ENSEMBL, 
                             lung_samples, drop=FALSE] + 1)    

                  
  # ENSEMBL → Symbol rowname 변환                                                                                                           
  rownames(mat_gs) <- gs_map$SYMBOL[match(rownames(mat_gs), gs_map$ENSEMBL)]
  mat_gs <- mat_gs[!duplicated(rownames(mat_gs)), ]                                                                                         
   
  # Z-score (유전자 기준, 행)                                                                                                               
  mat_gs_z <- t(scale(t(mat_gs)))  # genes × samples
  sum(is.na(mat_gs_z))                                                                                                                                  
  # ── 전치: samples(행) × genes(열) ────────────────────────────────────────────                                                           
  mat_plot <- t(mat_gs_z)
                                                                                                                                            
  # 행 순서: PD1-low 위, PD1-high 아래                                                                                                      
  low_rows  <- grep("lowPD1",  rownames(mat_plot), value=TRUE)
  high_rows <- grep("highPD1", rownames(mat_plot), value=TRUE)                                                                              
  mat_plot  <- mat_plot[c(low_rows, high_rows), ]                                                                                           
   
  # 열 순서: gene_set 입력 순서 유지                                                                                                        
  col_order <- gene_set[gene_set %in% colnames(mat_plot)]
  mat_plot  <- mat_plot[, col_order, drop=FALSE]                                                                                            
                  
  # ── 색상: blue(-1) → yellow(0) → red(1) ─────────────────────────────────────                                                            
  my_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(200)
  my_breaks <- seq(-2, 2, length.out=201)                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                            
  # ── 행 annotation (PD1 조건 표시) ────────────────────────────────────────────                                                           
  ann_row <- data.frame(                                                                                                                    
    Condition = ifelse(grepl("lowPD1",  rownames(mat_plot)), "PD1-low", "PD1-high"),                                                        
    row.names = rownames(mat_plot)                                                                                                          
  )
  ann_colors <- list(Condition = c("PD1-low" = "blue", "PD1-high" = "red"))                                                                 
                                                                                                                                            
  # ── Heatmap ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────                                                          
  pheatmap(mat_plot,                                                                                                                        
           cluster_rows   = FALSE,                                                                                                          
           cluster_cols   = FALSE,
           color          = my_colors,
           breaks         = my_breaks,
           annotation_row = ann_row,                                                                                                        
           annotation_colors = ann_colors,
           show_rownames  = TRUE,                                                                                                           
           show_colnames  = TRUE,
           fontsize_row   = 10,                                                                                                             
           fontsize_col   = 10,
           main           = "Gene set Z-score heatmap (Lung)")                                                                              
                                                                                                                                            
  pdf("bulkRNA_geneset_zscore_heatmap.pdf", width=5, height=4)
  pheatmap(mat_plot,                                                                                                                        
           cluster_rows   = FALSE,
           cluster_cols   = FALSE,                                                                                                          
           color          = my_colors,
           breaks         = my_breaks,                                                                                                      
           annotation_row = ann_row,
           annotation_colors = ann_colors,
           show_rownames  = TRUE,
           show_colnames  = TRUE,                                                                                                           
           fontsize_row   = 10,
           fontsize_col   = 10,                                                                                                             
           main           = "Gene set Z-score heatmap (Lung)")
  dev.off()
```
